title: LVM snapshots (1)
why: Made by hand or by another tool. bsweep snapshots lists each one with the command that removes it, for you to run once nobody needs it.

title: Snapper (3)
why: Deleted files stay on the disk while a snapshot holds them. bsweep snapshots lists each one with its date, and removes one with snapper, the newest always kept.

title: Btrfs snapshots (1)
why: Made by hand or by another tool. bsweep snapshots lists each one with the command that removes it, for you to run once nobody needs it.

title: Timeshift (2)
why: Deleted files stay on the disk while a snapshot holds them. bsweep snapshots lists each one with its date, and removes one with timeshift, the newest always kept. Their size can't be told.

title: ZFS snapshots (1)
why: Deleted files stay on the disk while a snapshot holds them. bsweep snapshots lists each one with its date, and removes one with zfs, the newest always kept.
